summary: Verified the P0 fix for ClientDetail blank-screen on iPhone (ErrorBoundary global + ClientDetail defensive normalization). Tested both accounts (super-admin pzsuave007 and card-only cardonly_test) on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080. ClientDetail renders cleanly in all combinations: client-name-heading present, fab-nuevo-button visible for super-admin, client-message-btn + client-upsell-negocio visible for card-only, history-tab-notas opens, adding a note (TEST_NOTE_iter37_QA) via note-input + note-add-btn succeeds with no crash, drawer 'Crear para QA' shows Mensaje/Cotización/Invoice/Contrato/Scope options. Performed navigation sweep on both accounts across /, /clientes, /quotes, /invoices, /contratos, /trabajos, /calendario, /tarjeta, /marketing, /mensajes, /citas, /ajustes, /notificaciones — the ErrorBoundary screen never appeared during normal navigation. FOUND AND FIXED one NEW unrelated P0 bug uncovered while testing the 'Mandar mensaje' flow: /app/frontend/src/pages/Messages.js was using useTranslation() and i18n.language without importing them, causing a ReferenceError: useTranslation is not defined on every visit to /mensajes (this is exactly where 'Mandar mensaje' navigates to). The new global ErrorBoundary correctly caught the crash and showed 'Algo salió mal' with detail (this is good — it validates the boundary works), but it still meant the Messages page was 100% broken. Added 'import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";' and 'import i18n from "@/i18n";' to Messages.js — after the fix, /mensajes loads correctly for both accounts and the Messages UI (AI Messages, Client selector pre-filled with the clicked client, Generate button, History list) renders fine. Re-ran all flows post-fix: zero ErrorBoundary triggers across the full nav sweep on both accounts and both viewports.

issues: Top language-suggest banner '¿Hablas español? Mira UniTech en tu idioma' shows on every page including the AI Messages page even after the user has chosen EN — minor UX nit carried over from previous iteration.

action_items: Please review the Messages.js import patch I applied (added `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';` and `import i18n from '@/i18n';`). This was a hard P0 crash on /mensajes for any user clicking 'Mandar mensaje' from a client detail. Consider running ESLint with no-undef enabled in CI to catch this class of regression — the same crash would have shown up immediately at build time.
(Optional) Honour the LanguageSuggestBanner dismissal flag on inner pages, not only on the Landing page — currently the banner re-appears on /mensajes, /citas, etc.
critical_code_review_comments: Messages.js used useTranslation() and i18n.language with NO matching import. This bypassed the test matrix because preview was already on a route where Messages never rendered until the new 'Mandar mensaje' flow added the entry point. Recommend turning on ESLint rule no-undef (and react/jsx-no-undef) as a hard error to prevent this from ever shipping again.

ErrorBoundary.js — implementation is solid: handleReset clears state cleanly, handleReload uses window.location.reload, copy-error button writes a useful payload (message, stack, componentStack, URL, UA). The wrapper RoutedErrorBoundary in App.js keyed on location.pathname is the right call — when the user navigates away after a crash, the boundary resets automatically. Validated end-to-end: when the Messages crash happened, switching to /clientes via direct URL change recovered cleanly because of the key reset.

ClientDetail.js defensive normalization (history arrays defaulted, Array.isArray(client.interests) guard, (m.message_type || '').replace()) confirmed working — pages render cleanly for both account types and viewports.

App.js correctly nests RoutedErrorBoundary INSIDE AuthProvider and BrowserRouter — so a crash inside the auth context tree (e.g. AuthProvider itself) would NOT be caught by this boundary. That is acceptable given AuthProvider is simple and unlikely to throw, but worth noting if auth ever grows.

rca_of_the_issue: Original P0 (ClientDetail blank screen on iPhone): main agent's mitigation verified — global ErrorBoundary (data-testid=error-boundary-screen) and defensive normalization in ClientDetail.load() both confirmed working. The boundary even caught the *new* unrelated Messages.js ReferenceError crash and showed the friendly recovery screen with the real stack trace, exactly as designed (no more blank white screen). RCA of the new bug found during testing: Messages.js called useTranslation() at line 26 and i18n.language at line 27 without importing either. Likely introduced when migrating Messages.js to bilingual strings; the build did not fail because CRA/Webpack only treats undefined globals as runtime errors, not build errors. Fix: added two imports at top of Messages.js. Mitigation for future: enable ESLint no-undef as error level in CI.
